entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and order number to start?
Mark Peterson. Order number is VF78901.
Thank you, Mark. I have your order right here for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. To understand how I can best help you, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The heart rate monitor is wildly inaccurate. Honestly, the thing is a piece of **garbage**.
I'm very sorry to hear you're experiencing that. I'd be happy to walk you through a couple of quick steps to see if we can resolve the issue. It usually just takes a minute or two.
No. I **don't have time** for that. I'm not your tech support. I just want a **refund**.
I understand you're frustrated. For a defect claim, we do need to try and verify the issue first. Without troubleshooting, I would have to process this as a standard return based on preference.
Fine. Do that then. I **just want money** back for it.
Okay, not a problem. Let me just check the return eligibility for you. I see the item was delivered 23 days ago, on December 15th.
Just one moment while I check our policy... Okay, I've confirmed it. Our return policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery.
Since you are well within that 90-day window, I can go ahead and approve this return for you immediately. I'll email a prepaid shipping label to the address on file.

The email has just been sent, Mark. Once our warehouse receives the item, you'll see the full refund processed back to your original payment method within 5-7 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good rest of your day.
